This practice acted aggressively and unreasonably, not me, with their threatening letter, saying i was to take it as a written warning and may result in me being kicked out of the doctors practice if any similar occurrence happens in future.

It really has gone downhill.
Way to many patients and not enough appointment slots, plus they need more reception staff, as an hour and half wait on the phone to be then  told all appointment slots are filled for that day is unacceptable and unreasonable.
